findings.title: Independently clean owned descendants when the parent-death test fails
findings.problem: parent_death kills its parent then relies on the mechanisms under test to stop worker/guardian. Unexpected survivors are only reported; finally handles only parent, with TERM/wait but no KILL fallback. Startup-timeout/driver interruption can also leave already spawned descendants. A failed cleanup test must not leave its benign owned tasks running.
findings.artificial_reproduction: FakePopen parent999; recorded worker1001 andguardian1002 remain running. Function returns passedfalse/worker_runningtrue/guardian_runningtrue; recorded cleanup action is only kill999. No real process or Linux operation performed.
findings.required: Bind own descendants before deliberate parent death via pidfds or equivalent verified identity; independent finally TERM/KILL/reap/status check for parent/worker/guardian on success/failure/startup/driver interruption. Preserve observed testFAIL even if fallback cleanup succeeds; never broaden kills to unrelated processes.

findings.title: Protect the whole validation driver with an independent deadline controller
findings.problem: 1800s total is a Python SIGALRM raising an exception in the same driver. full_mesh performs NumPy/SciPy assembly/norm and fileIO directly in that process, so Python signal handling can be delayed until native/blocked operations return. Imports and output-root creation also precede timer start. The guarded cost worker does not provide an independent deadline for this whole driver.
findings.required: Freeze an independent outer owned-process deadline wrapper for the complete driver lifecycle, reserve cleanup/reporting within1800s, propagate stops/parent death, and charge actual full wall/cost. In-process alarm may remain as a secondary cooperative check. Test outer timeout/exception with harmless substitutions; reviewer does not perform actual Linux admission.

Fail before any scientific work on altered card/root; no post-run-only cap enforcement.

findings.title: Set the shared CPU/thread/zero-GPU policy before first numerical import
findings.problem: main imports hybrid_inputs->NumPy/SciPy before host_admission sets calling-thread affinity. Already created BLAS threads can retain the old affinity. Cost/helper env inherits shell settings and does not set the formal runner OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/NUMEXPR16, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty or runlocal temp/cache policy. Thus the requested shared<=16core and matched actual-worker cost environment are not established by this entry.

Record actual settings and apply to relevant threads if inherited runtime already exists. No GPU admission/run needed for this fix.
